name: Bill
bio: Came for the barbecue. Stayed for the firefight.
notes: Drive intake of 2026-11-05 ("T Pose on Green Screen", rigged and animated on Meshy (Mixamo joint names read as Meshy's; finger chains refitted by hands.mjs: `fixes.fingers: fit`, the grip audit scored its own finger weights worse, 5 against 3; its clips not used)). A grey-haired man with a moustache in a patterned short-sleeved shirt, jeans and brown shoes. Not the CRT Robot (owner, 2026-11-05: "we can call Bill"); a new character. Its name sits close to Bill the Barbarian's (meshy_hector): kept as "Bill" (owner's name), the owner told. 145k triangles: rebaked.
